v1: A fraud victim's evidence is scattered across chats, screenshots and Hindi voice notes. No one can see the full picture.
v2: TraceVault seals every file first: hashed, encrypted, and logged in a tamper-evident chain. Then our ML pipelines go to work.
v3a: Two OCR pipelines: on-device for English, Sarvam Vision for Indic scripts. You choose what may leave the machine.
v3b: Hindi, Hinglish and Kannada become searchable, with the original always cited.
v4: It resolves one person across every account, and finds the money trail.
v5: System1 classifies the incident type. Then read-only AI agents investigate: they check evidence quality, search the case with citations, trace the money and list the evidence gaps. Every answer links back to its source.
v6a: Where sources disagree, like an edited screenshot, it flags it for a human.
v6b: The sealed report includes a draft Section 63 certificate.
v7: This is the technical architecture of the product and additional features that we implemented.
